GOV-F-004-S40.title: Audit Log Storage Schema and Append-Only Contract
GOV-F-004-S40.description: Define and implement the MongoDB collection schema for audit logs including immutable fields, hash chaining fields (prev_hash, current_hash), timestamps, actor (GPT/Claude), operation type, and payload metadata. Enforce append-only behavior at the data access layer (no updates/deletes).

GOV-F-004-S41.title: Audit Logging Service Core Logic
GOV-F-004-S41.description: Build a centralized audit logging service responsible for generating audit events, computing hash chains, and persisting records using the append-only schema. Ensure consistent usage across GPT and Claude operations and support structured event types.

GOV-F-004-S42.title: Audit Log Access API (Read-Only)
GOV-F-004-S42.description: Expose secure, read-only API endpoints for retrieving audit logs for QA, SIT, and governance review. Include filtering by time range, operation type, and actor, while enforcing strict no-mutation guarantees.

GOV-F-004-S43.title: Audit Logging Test Suite (Unit + Integration)
GOV-F-004-S43.description: Create unit and integration tests validating append-only enforcement, hash chain correctness, event completeness, and integration with runtime hooks. Include tamper simulation scenarios to verify detection.
